subject: website
name: Jose Storopoli
summary: Jose Storopoli's personal blog. Its source is public (MIT). The home page loads only its own files, but several posts embed YouTube players that load as the post opens, third-party code the reader did not ask for, so it stays Level 2. Some posts also load diagrams from mermaid.ink.

connections.note: Embedded in several posts; loaded as each post opens.
